name: KiCad Library Manager
description: Manage a shared KiCad DBL parts library with requests/sync and previews.
description_full: An IPC plugin for KiCad 9+ (PCB Editor) that manages a shared database-backed library repo (sqlite/DBL) across multiple users. Includes request submission via GitHub, repo sync helpers, browsing/editing parts, and bootstrap tools for a new DB repo. Requires Preferences → Plugins → Enable KiCad API. On Linux, install python3-pip, python3-venv, and python3-wxgtk4.0 so KiCad can create the plugin Python environment (do not pip-install wxPython).
